# Khata Saathi

> Voice and text udhaar-khata ledger assistant for small shopkeepers in Pakistan.

## Key Pages
- `/` — Product overview, how it works, trust guarantees, and FAQ
- `/app` — Shop counter voice/text entry dashboard and customer list
- `/privacy` — Local-first privacy policy (no analytics, draft-only reminders)
- `/terms` — Terms of use (record-keeping tool; not financial advice or a payment system)

## Architecture
- `packages/core`: Deterministic Roman Urdu & Urdu script parser, integer-only append-only ledger, 7 port interfaces
- `apps/api`: Fastify + Zod + SQLite API with `/health/providers`
- `apps/web`: React + Vite + TypeScript offline-capable PWA
